title: Seller Onboarding Jurisdiction Classifier
description: Determine W-8/W-9 form requirement by seller country and entity type. Classify FATCA/CRS status. Determine VAT treatment for marketplace services. Outputs onboarding checklist, decision tree, and Policy Mandate JSON seller profile stub. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
